'''Mookiee''' was a strong but not intelligent huntress in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who who [[Marriage/Legends|wed]] a handsome but weak [[Prince/Legends|prince]]. "Mookiee" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]],<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Mookiee|the Ewok]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="Ewoks">{{Ewoks|The Cries of the Trees}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Mookiee was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
